\[
\int \exp(x)\cos(x)\,dx = \frac{\exp(x)(\sin(x)+\cos(x))}{2} + C
\]

So:

\[
\int -3*\exp(x)*\cos(x)\,dx
= -3 * \frac{\exp(x)(\sin(x)+\cos(x))}{2} + C
\]

<answer>-3*exp(x)*(sin(x)+cos(x))/2 + C</answer>
